turns.question: By what percentage was revenue on Thursday 24 September 2026 up on the same weekday a week earlier?
turns.answer: Revenue on 24 September 2026 was up 21.1% on Thursday 17 September 2026 (week-over-week growth of 0.2112, single day 2026-09-24). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
